notes.title: Our Last Scheduled Patch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41032306/3f1287d27e3f265fe44ac5077b64bb30d1799eab.png[/img]

Hi everyone!

On Monday, April 3rd, we posted Update Patch 15, and that was our last scheduled monthly patch for Curse of the Deadwood!

We thank you all for the feedback you've given us along the way, and we hope that you are enjoying the game. We've put so much love and care into improving the game performance and details since we started the monthly patches, and we hope this made it more playable for everyone!

All this to say thank you for your support, and while this was our last scheduled patch, we'll always monitor feedback and come back to fix any major bugs that prevent gameplay! Have fun smashing Deadwood!

notes.title: Curse of the Deadwood Special Announcement!
notes.content:
Hello Woodlings!!! First, we wanted to thank you all so very much for being a part of our world. We put a ton of pride and love into Curse of the Deadwood and we're so grateful for everyone who has supported us along the way.

Over the past 3 months, we've been continuously striving to improve the Curse of the Deadwood gaming experience for all of you, and have made some tremendous progress in terms of game speed, game size, and overall performance. Moving forward, we will be pushing out patch updates once a month as opposed to twice a month. These monthly patches will continue to address any gaming experience issues, but will also still be squashing any bugs that are discovered along the way. Our next patch should be available by mid January, 2023. 

Again, thank you so much for your support, we love you all! Happy Holidays to you and yours from all of us at Steamroller.

notes.title: Curse of the Deadwood Major Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41032306/98a1e0bf842fa2a9c9b56f0357b40e8bfcbfe44b.png[/img]

Hello! We’re so excited to announce yet another Curse of the Deadwood Patch! This patch took us a bit longer, and we’re so grateful for your patience.

Here’s what’s our team has been up to:
[list]
[*] First: the size of the game overall. Yes, we’re aware of how large of a download Curse of the Deadwood is, and we’ve discovered a few reasons why and addressed those. So, the game download size is now reduced by 60-70%.
[*] Secondly, we’ve done a substantial amount of optimization for some performance challenges to make gameplay much more enjoyable.
[/list]
Here's a full list of the tweaks and optimization that our amazing team has been clicking away on:

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h3]Enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved the ability for deadwood enemies to navigate the Quartermaster's arena
[/list]
[h3]Stability[/h3]
[list]
[*] Remastered and removed a large number of game files to GREATLY reduce the size of the game
[*] Implemented a new grass system to further improve performance
[*] Optimized some models and effects to improve performance for multiple levels
[/list]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a Grass Quality setting to the video options to allow for more refined control of the amount of grass on screen
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed an errant UI element that caused Leafton to appear darker than intended
[/list]
[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] While this patch greatly improves the game's performance we will continue to look for ways to improve it more
[*] Some shadows may appear to flicker
[/list]
Thanks again so much for your support and patience. We hope that these improvements will help to enhance your game play! Now... go smash some deadwood!

notes.title: Curse of the Deadwood Performance Update
notes.content:
Hello! We hope everyone is enjoying Curse of the Deadwood! Just a quick update regarding game performance and steps that we are taking as a team to address…

First, our team continues to work on Curse of the Deadwood and we continue to address performance challenges as well as other bug fixes. We are aware that the game performance is not optimal, especially when trying to hit very high frame rates. Please know that we are striving to reach those expectations. 

Steam Deck is also currently being addressed. At this time, we have not yet certified Curse of the Deadwood for Steam Deck. We are, however, working on optimizing the game for Steam Deck performance. Our team will continue to work on delivering an optimized performance for both PC AND Steam Deck.

In terms of delivery time for Steam Deck, we do ask for your patience, but we will be working on this over the next few months to deliver a certified version for Steam Deck while also enhancing frame rate and performance for PC. It’s our goal to be able to deliver this before the Holidays.

Again, thanks so much for your support and patience!

Gratefully,
The Steamroller Animation Team

notes.title: Curse of the Deadwood Patch Plan
notes.content:
First off a huge thank you! We are so excited for the world to play Curse of the Deadwood!

Though we’ve tried our best to make Curse of the Deadwood as stable and bug free as possible, we are still a relatively small team for a game of this size, and we know that there are still some outstanding issues. Please know that we are actively working on fixes and will continue to fix bugs as time goes on.

Our plan is to release a patch next week that will address a few issues that we are aware of now, and then continue a cycle of releasing a patch every two weeks or as close to that as we can. Should any major issues be reported, we will prioritize those first and release hotfixes for them as soon as possible.

Should you run into any bugs, please help us out and report them on our website: [url=https://curseofthedeadwood.com/report-a-bug]curseofthedeadwood.com/report-a-bug[/url]

We really appreciate you all and please know that our team will continue to make Deadwood a great experience.

Gratefully,
The Steamroller Animation Team

notes.title: Curse of the Deadwood Steam DECK Performance Update

Please know that we're totally aware that Curse of the Deadwood is not performing optimally at this point on [b]Steam Deck[/b]. We are currently diligently working on optimizing the game for Steam Deck. 

We'll keep you all up to date when updates become available.  Thank you for your support and your patience!

If you do happen to find a bug, please report it here so that we can address it in patches down the road: [url=https://www.curseofthedeadwood.com/report-a-bug]https://www.curseofthedeadwood.com/report-a-bug[/url].

Thank you!
The Steamroller Animation Team.

Curse of the Deadwood is a unique couch co-op evolution of the twin-stick genre that will have you taking simultaneous control of two unlikely friends as they fight their way through hordes of wooden zombies. Balance a varied arsenal of long-ranged weapons with devastating melee and magic attacks. Only by working together will you be able to save the Woodlings’ beautiful world of Knottington from the Curse of the Deadwood.

notes.title: GET READY! Curse of the Deadwood To Launch July 28, 2022
notes.content:
When 3 close friends all decided to create a video game almost 9 years ago, they
had NO idea that their idea would pave the way for an animation company that
works on some of the biggest games on the planet including Fortnite, Mortal
Kombat 11, Wolfenstein II, CyberPunk 2077, and Horizon Forbidden West. With
ambition, talent, and a love for gaming, the trio has grown the studio from 3
owners to 163 team members all over the globe. And NOW, they get to release their
very own game, Curse of the Deadwood.

Curse of the Deadwood is a beautifully animated tale of an enchanted land called
Knottington. Join the epic journey of two unlikely heroes as they work side by side
to defeat hordes of wooden zombies, save the Woodlings, and preserve the
beauty and splendor of Knottington. Wield a variety of weapons, unlock upgrades,
and fine tune them along the way to wipe out the menacing wooden zombies. This
action packed evolution of a twin-stick, couch co-op game will leave gamers
asking for more.

Adam Meyer, co-owner of Steamroller shares his thoughts on the much awaited
release. “Seeing this game come to life has been a dream of mine for years. Our
team at Steamroller Studios dove right into the story, they practically immersed
themselves in Knottington. Creating epic content like this is what helps our studio
stay connected, stay relevant, and continues to help us move forward in the
industry. I’m so grateful to our entire team for the love that they poured into this
game and I can’t wait for the world to play it!”

notes.title: Meet Lathe : Curse of the Deadwood
notes.content:
Our epic twin-stick, couch co-op game will be here before you know it! We wanted you to get to know the cast and crew of Curse of the Deadwood so that you can hit the ground running saving Knottington from the Curse.

Meet Lathe!

[url=https://curseofthedeadwood.com][img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/624f1a8aa980980d0eb29b4a/ec657b14-415b-4a30-8c6a-e8f9bf1133e5/lathe.png?format=500w[/img][/url]
An avid inventor with a tendency to daydream most of his hours away, works as an apprentice to Radley, the old Keeper of Deadwood Pass. The Keepers job is to watch over the almighty tree of Deadwood Forest, and to make sure no-one ever plucks its wicked seeds.

We invite you to learn more about our characters at [url=https://curseofthedeadwood.com]https://curseofthedeadwood.com[/url]

We can't wait for you to play!

Our shiny new website features screenshots, character information, Curse of the Deadwood news, and highlights some of the characters from the game. We hope you enjoy, and stay tuned for game launch updates!

notes.title: Curse Of The Deadwood To Launch With Couch Co-Op Functionality!
notes.content:
You and your friends will LOVE our couch co-op functionality as you take simultaneous control of two unlikely friends as they fight their way through hordes of wooden zombies. Balance a varied arsenal of long-ranged weapons with devastating melee and magic attacks. Only by working together will you be able to save the Woodlings’ beautiful world of Knottington from the Curse of the Deadwood.

Learn more about [url=https://curseofthedeadwood.com]Curse Of The Deadwood here![/url]
